name: Tandem Ciders
address: 2055 N Setterbo Rd, Suttons Bay, MI 49682
description: One of Michigan's most acclaimed cideries, Tandem uses locally sourced Leelanau and Old Mission Peninsula apples to craft small-batch, terroir-driven ciders. Their rustic barn tasting room is a must-visit.

name: Suttons Bay Ciders
address: 715 S Maple St, Suttons Bay, MI 49682
description: Family-friendly cidery with panoramic views of West Grand Traverse Bay. Known for creative fruit-forward ciders using local apples, cherries, berries, and lavender sourced from Leelanau Peninsula farms.

name: Taproot Cider House
address: 215 E Front St, Traverse City, MI 49686
description: Downtown Traverse City's premier cider destination, featuring house-crafted hard ciders, spirits, and a farm-to-table food menu. Live music, outdoor patio, and a welcoming atmosphere make this a TC favorite.

name: Northern Natural Cider House
address: 324 E Front St, Traverse City, MI 49686
description: A downtown TC gem focusing on natural, low-intervention ciders and wines made from Michigan fruit. The relaxed tasting room environment and commitment to organic practices make it a standout among local producers.

name: Bel Lago Winery & Cidery
address: 6530 S Lake Shore Dr, Cedar, MI 49621
description: Estate winery and cidery set on a stunning Lake Leelanau property. Bel Lago crafts both award-winning wines and heritage-style hard ciders using estate-grown and locally sourced fruit in a beautiful lakeside setting.

name: Left Foot Charley Cider
description: Bryan Ulbrich's celebrated natural winery also produces some of Michigan's finest artisan hard ciders. Using the same minimal-intervention philosophy applied to his wines, Left Foot Charley ciders are complex, dry, and unlike anything else in the region.
